subject: Post-discovery next steps — propose two tight 30m windows + optional workshop
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenovate.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery next steps — propose two tight 30m windows + optional workshop

Hi Elena —

Great conversation earlier today — thanks for walking through Zenovate's search and summarization use cases. Quick recap from my side:
- Primary goal: reduce average time-to-insight on internal docs + customer tickets (target: 40% faster).
- Key constraints: PII redaction pipeline, regional data residency in US-only, and SSO via Okta.
- Immediate success criteria: proof-of-concept that can handle a 2k-doc corpus with <500ms median latency for embeddings and acceptable cost profile.

Next step: a 30-minute product intro (high level + brief ops touch) to align stakeholders and confirm a technical deep-dive owner. I have two compact windows that work for our team:
1) Wed Aug 2 — 10:30–11:00 PT
2) Thu Aug 3 — 14:00–14:30 PT

If neither works, I'm happy to propose two evening options (US-PST) or a single 45-minute slot that includes a short workshop for your infra folks.

Can you please confirm: which window you prefer, and whether Mark (your security lead) should be at the initial 30-min? If he prefers, we can instead do a brief separate security Q&A with our Security & Compliance lead.

I've attached a short one-pager and a draft mutual action plan to speed procurement/PO conversations. Also dropping a calendar link: https://cal.example.com/jordan/zenovate-30m

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood_one_pager.pdf (1 page), mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf (3 pages)

Thanks Jordan — really helpful recap.

Both windows are promising. Can we lock Thu Aug 3 14:00–14:30 PT? That slot works best for our PM and me.

A couple of quick asks before we confirm formally:
- Please include a short line on how Redwood handles SSO/KMS at a high level (we'll need to share with our security team).
- I'd like Mark Tan (CTO) and our infra lead copied for the technical deep dive. Mark's email is mark.tan@zenovate.com — he'll likely want to join the second session (technical deep dive) rather than the 30-min intro, but cc'ing him early helps.

If you think it's useful, we can opt for a 45-minute opener that includes a 10-minute workshop exercise (bring one sample dataset). Otherwise the 30-min intro is fine and we schedule the technical deep-dive for next week.

Elena
Head of Product | Zenovate
elena.rossi@zenovate.com
